summary.text: Hildy Angius, a Republican, has represented District 30 in the Arizona State Senate since January 2025 and is not running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she was elected to the Mohave County Board of Supervisors, District 2 (Bullhead City), in 2012 and served 12 years, three times as chairman.
Angius was born in New York and lives in Bullhead City, and Ballotpedia says she graduated from the State University of New York at Albany in 1983 with a degree in English and theater.
